_status: UNVERIFIED. Same discipline as setbacks_v1: every entry cites a source and carries "verified": false until someone checks it against NBC 2016 Part 3 itself. These are minimum *legal* room sizes — a plan built to a wrong minimum is not a smaller mistake than a wrong setback.
_minimums: NBC 2016 Part 3 sets area and width floors for habitable rooms, kitchens and sanitary spaces. `target_area_sq_m` is NOT from the code — it is what an Indian architect would draw when the budget allows, and is the solver's slack, not a legal figure.
_sectors: Vastu placement conventions, advisory throughout. Kitchen south-east is the Agni corner; master bedroom south-west; pooja north-east; sanitary north-west. Schools disagree — CLAUDE.md's position is that the ruleset version producing a score is always shown, and the user or their consultant owns the verdict.

car_parking.road_access_source: A bay a car cannot drive into is not a bay. Karnataka Municipalities Model Building Bye-Laws 2017 cl. 5.1.8.2 governs the garage's size, not its access; the access requirement is physical rather than statutory.

_aspect: Longest side over shortest. 2.5 is a habitable room — beyond that it reads as a passage. Circulation is exempt because being long is its function: a corridor flagged as 'a corridor, not a corridor' is the rule mistaking the shape for the defect. Not a code figure; practice.
_edition: Cited as NBC 2016 Part 3 with NO amendment number, because the document was never read — the figures are transcribed from practice knowledge. NBC 2016 (SP 7 : 2016) is still the current edition, but BIS issues amendments and we do not know which apply to Part 3 or whether they move these minimums. Confirming that is VERIFY.md Q5. When a figure is checked, record the amendment it was checked against alongside `verified: true`.
_verified_2017: Five figures confirmed against the Karnataka Municipalities Model Building Bye-Laws 2017 (UDD 14 TTP 2017 (P-4), 28-10-2017), downloaded from BBMP's own BPAS portal and read first-hand. The rest remain transcribed from practice. Note cl. 1(3): FAR, setback, coverage and height are governed by the Master Plan and Zonal Regulations, NOT by these bye-laws — so `setbacks_v1.json` is a separate question and is still unverified.
_scope: For Bengaluru the operative document is the Karnataka Municipalities Model Building Bye-Laws 2017, not NBC 2016. NBC is the national model code; Karnataka adopted and adapted it, and a BBMP sanction is checked against the Karnataka version. Citing NBC was one level too abstract. Entries still marked 'practice, not code' are conventions with no legal floor found in the 2017 document — a plan violating one is unusual, not illegal.
_walk_in: Whether a person reaches this space through the house. It decides two things that must agree: which rooms stage ⑥ guarantees a door to, and which rooms stage ⑦ reports as stranded. They were separate hardcoded sets in two modules until this existed — one list in `refine` and an identical one in `validator` — which is a drift waiting to happen: ⑥ connecting one set while ⑦ checks another would read as a clean plan. False only for the car porch, which is entered from the street.
